newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia 97/98 wheat pool A$170-A$180/T - AWB.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia 97/98 wheat pool A$170-A$180/T - AWB.

text.p: The opening pool price for 1997/98 Australian Standard White (ASW) wheat would be A$170 to A$180 a tonne, AWB spokeswoman Joan McGovern said on Tuesday.
McGovern said this after the AWB announced a A$1.00 a tonne increase in current crop pool prices for most wheat grades on Monday night.
This brought the ASW pool price to A$193 a tonne.
The AWB said two weeks ago it intended to release its first 1997/98 pool returns estimate on February 17 but did not do so.

McGovern's statement on the A$170 to A$180 a tonne estimate for first ASW 1997/98 pool returns repeats a prediction on opening 1997/98 pool prices by AWB chairman Trevor Flugge two weeks ago at the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics (ABARE) Outlook '97 conference.
